name: Madhav Pandya
bio: I'm Madhav Pandya, from Mumbai, and the founder of CyberWithMadhav. I'm pursuing a BCA in Cloud Computing and Cyber Security and a BA LLB at KES Shri J.P. Law College, and I explain cybersecurity and scam awareness in plain English and Hinglish so beginners can learn it and families can spot scams before they lose money.

lawCallout.title: Why I study law alongside cybersecurity
lawCallout.body: Most security content explains how attacks work. Studying law means I also look at what the law says about them, and what organisations must do to comply.
points: IT Act, 2000: unauthorised access (civil wrong under s.43; offence under s.66 if done dishonestly or fraudulently), identity theft (s.66C) and cheating by impersonation (s.66D)
Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023: consent, data-fiduciary duties and breach obligations
CERT-In directions: incident reporting for organisations
GRC: turning these rules into policies, risk registers and audits
